allocations.scope: Renderer-owned buffer/texture payload requests. Excludes diagnostic readback helper allocations, pipelines, alignment, driver/browser/compositor and residency.

lightCache.units: relative scene-linear RGB radiance / irradiance; not absolute SI calibrated
lightCache.latency: complete snapshot, six-frame angular build; direct shadow current frame

phase0.note: Experimental toggles are Phase 0 hypotheses, not accepted features.

userAgent: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/156.0.0.0 Safari/537.36

foamPatternCalibration.scope: Texture-texel threshold coverage only. Bilinear sampling, shading footprint and evolving foam density require separate validation.

surfaceProbe.scope: Asynchronous camera-point height; optical classification uses the current GPU near-plane map.

memoryEstimate.note: Analytic lower bound for main MSAA/depth/HDR/bloom/cloud render targets only. Excludes simulation, driver alignment, browser compositor, and transient resources.

continuousSpectrum.model: JONSWAP / Elfouhaily hybrid; normalized band-limited swell

spectral.observationalStatus: UNVERIFIED: one realization, linear slopes; Cox-Munk uses U12.5, not U10; no ensemble confidence interval.
spectral.whitecapStatus: UNVERIFIED: no long-duration, area-weighted coverage observation.
spectral.tolerance: Parseval <0.0015 includes binary16 storage; conjugate coefficients <1e-7. Zero NaN/Inf in sampled fields.

foam.interpretation: Simulation-memory density over uniform parameter-space texels, not observed projected optical whitecap coverage. A single instant cannot validate a wind-coverage fit.

hdr.scope: All RGB samples in pre-exposed resolved linear HDR, before bloom and tone mapping. Bands undo storage divisor, retain renderer-relative radiance units; no sky/ocean segmentation.

light.convention: shadow RG direct Sun/Moon transmittance; B supported precipitation; A regional event. Cubes +X -X +Y -Y +Z -Z. Relative linear RGB.
